==Descriptions==
'''Hallows Ville''' was a map originally planned for the [[Halloween 2019 Event]] but then went unused. Later, there was a possibility of it getting brought back for the [[Halloween 2020 Event]], which also ultimately never happened.<ref>[[File:HallowsVilleDiscordMessage.png|280px]]https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/587355301674614854/736842940831367190</ref>

==Design & Path==
'''Hallows Ville''' is a town surrounded by a sea full of a green liquid, possibly acid, and multiple tall mountains. The town contains black houses with neon orange windows, various gravestones and fences. Around the houses, dead trees, lamps and statues can also be seen.

The path starts and ends at a cave.
